race.comment: Some strong country form lines come together in the last. ROLLING HOME (2) has won two from two this prep, the latest a dominant all-the-way display in a Class 1 over 1300m at Scone. Gets to this trip for the first time but is lightly raced and showed no signs of stopping last time. AWESOME ARTIST (3) came with a well-timed run to just arrive in time first-up over 1400m at Nowra. That was the first run since arriving in the David Pfieffer yard so there could be further improvement in him. Draws gate one and is right in contention. WANDJAD (1) made it three on the bounce when he stormed home to win under today's steadier of 60.5kgs at Muswellbrook recently. Building an outstanding association with Gibbons who stays aboard for this. FAMOSO (6) got the job done at Canberra last start and while this is tougher he cannot be ruled out. Gap to the next chance ZIGGY ROSE (8) who resumes. One for the exotics.
